payload.reason: The evidence provides specific prior approaches for style transfer that were tested, including rule-based methods, Multi-Attribute Style Transfer (MAST), and Adversarial Style Transfer (AdvST).

claims.text: The study tests a rule-based method for style transfer, which fails in content fidelity due to structural differences.
Multi-Attribute Style Transfer (MAST) is tested, which models multiple attributes and uses back-translation.
Adversarial Style Transfer (AdvST) is also tested, which combines back-translation with adversarial training.
